RESOLVE.name: Close the dispute

REQUEST_INFO.description: A note to the party who opened it; the dispute stays open and the milestone held.

OPEN.name: Open a new dispute
OPEN.description: Records DISPUTE_OPENED. The milestone is held until the buyer closes it validly.
